what: The run scripts read the blaze to use from one file, `/root/bin/latest`, at each step: installing a newer blaze while a cold-build-then-edit chain ran would have run the edit under another binary and home. Caught before it happened.
cause: a shared mutable pointer between a build lane and a measuring chain
workaround: pinned `latest` until the chain ended; a chain should take its binary as an argument
